title: Audit and reconstruction of the frozen EXP-003 T4 downstream pathway
question: Are T4b and T4c absent from the EXP-003 downstream materialization because MaleCNS lacks their outputs, or because the target selection is incomplete?

preserved_baselines.EXP-003: unchanged initial embodied result from aeccf1c; this audit is a separate comparison record

bridge.readout: descending activity weighted by normalized T4a path mass minus normalized T4d path mass

audit.root_cause: The original query retained only HSE, HSN, HSS, HST, VS, VST1, VST2, and VSm as direct T4 targets. That target-type filter excluded the direct T4b/T4c lobula-plate paths.

literature_basis.use: T4 axons terminate in one of four retinotopic lobula-plate layers, and T4/T5 synaptic partners include common same-layer motion-integration pathways.
T4a-d are four cardinal direction channels whose signals are integrated by lobula-plate tangential cells through direct excitation and indirect LPi inhibition.
All four T4 subtypes project to their own lobula-plate layer, supporting an all-subtype downstream audit rather than treating T4b/c absence as biological.

corrected_materialization.direct_target_rule: post superclass in {visual_projection, visual_centrifugal} OR post type starts with LPi

pathway_ablation.operation: remove all corrected T4 -> lobula_plate_target matrix entries before descending readout

interpretation.pre_body_command_sign: The corrected forward and reverse commands are both predominantly negative; neither condition produces an opposite-signed command. The corrected path changes timing and magnitude, not sign.
interpretation.body_sign: Both corrected conditions still produce positive final yaw, with reverse slightly larger than forward.
interpretation.causal_result: Corrected-path ablation removes the corrected order contrast, so the remaining small embodied difference is downstream-path-dependent under this frozen bridge.
interpretation.subtype_information: MaleCNS connectivity now preserves all four subtype-specific T4 paths into selected lobula-plate targets and descending neurons. The frozen motor bridge still explicitly contrasts T4a and T4d path mass; T4b/T4c are not given new hand-coded motor signs in this audit.
interpretation.claim_limit: This is a downstream graph audit and a dimensionless graded activity-proxy result, not evidence of canonical left/right or front/back steering.
interpretation.unresolved_biological_ambiguity: The workbook mapping from 01_07 -> 01_08 to canonical visual/body direction remains unresolved. The conservative corrected graph is two hops; additional LPi-mediated multi-hop integration may matter but was not added here.
